description: Exports the hardware configuration as CAx / AutomationML (.aml) to a file on the serve host: one device when `device` is given, otherwise the whole project. Writes the file only — the project is not changed. Returns the transfer state, errors, warnings and messages (capped; messagesTruncated); a transfer whose state is Error or that counts any error is an error (500 cax_transfer_failed, those fields in details), and `unreadable` flags an outcome that could not be fully read. Serves up to app 1.6.3 return only an opaque `result` string even when the transfer failed — check the outcome with tia_devices. Maps to POST /cax/export {device?, file}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

device.description: device name to export (omit for the whole project)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

file.description: target .aml file path on the serve host

name: tia_cax_export
title: TIA — CAx export (AutomationML)
